summary: Hf-doped ZnO (HZO) films were deposited by atomic layer deposition (ALD) at 220 °C using diethyl zinc (DEZ), tetrakis (ethylmethylamino) hafnium (TEMAH), and deionized water (DI-water) as precursors. The study investigated the structural, optical, and electrical properties of HZO films as a function of Hf-doping concentration. The films exhibited a hexagonal structure with preferential orientation changing from a-axis to c-axis with increasing Hf-doping. The minimum resistivity of 1.6 × 10⁻³ Ω cm was achieved for the HZO film with 4.6 at.% Hf.
